tools.name: manage_sync
tools.description: Manage local SMM sync. status starts/reuses the service and returns its state; open opens its status page; sync runs one sync; pause persists a pause for automatic sync; resume reenables it. A manual sync leaves the pause setting unchanged.

tools.name: set_source_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a registered local conversation source by ID.

tools.name: configure_hub
tools.description: Configure Hub lookup and this computer's name. New connections do not upload dialogue until a Web/CLI upload choice. Use a credential file, never its contents in chat.

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Search local and configured Hub candidates together, reranked locally; unuploaded local conversations participate. Project scope uses Hub direct links online, only the requested local project on Hub failure; local=true uses local links. Pass the returned reference to read_conversation for exact evidence. Previews default to 600 characters.

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read original messages using the exact search reference. Old integer/hub_id/message_id calls remain supported; never reuse another archive's numeric ID.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List project IDs, source paths, direct links, and conversation counts for choosing search scope.

tools.name: resolve_project
tools.description: Find the configured project for a working directory or its nearest parent.

tools.name: list_document_sources
tools.description: List explicitly configured local document sources, projects and refresh/error coverage. No scan. Configure with Web or smm documents; supports UTF-8 Markdown/TXT only.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search captured local text documents only, with local direct project links. Never searches Hub or scans files. Results include capture version, coverage and a signed reference; use read_document for evidence.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a captured document using its exact search reference. Default is the hit window; optional whole-file Unicode codepoint [start,end) range, max16000. Old versions/qualifications require a new search. No source-file read.
